page.overview:
Who is Ozkan the Codifier?

Ozkan the Codifier is a Necron Cryptek of the Suhbekhar Dynasty located within the Jericho Reach.

Though loyal to his dynasty, he secretly works behind Overlord-Regent Ahhotekh's back to not only revive the Phaeron Ahmontekh, the so-called "Crimson Scythe," but house his ancient master in a body of flesh and bone.

Ozkan has served the Suhbekhar Dynasty with unstinting loyalty since the earliest days of the War in Heaven, providing sage counsel to the Crimson Scythe in those comparatively few moments when the phaeron was not shedding the blood of entire species and laying waste to great swathes of the galaxy in the service of the C'tan.

The cryptek was known as the only being his master would tolerate voicing anything other than soothing platitudes, for so often Ozkan was proven to be entirely correct in his advice, even when it gainsaid Ahmontekh's own intentions.
